description.narrative: Eco-Congregations is part of the Christian environmental organisation A Rocha. Re A Rocha discussion, there were two key elements to our discussion, one was the succession plan for David Hughes who is retiring, which feeds into the replacement livesimply award co-ordinator and the other is the more general changes to strategy and are for general interest as there are some major changes coming up. A Rocha has 15-20 paid staff and 60-70 key volunteers most but not all based in West London working with Christian churches and individuals. Their role is to inspire and equip individuals and groups to work on sustainability issues within a Christian church context. In December 2013, three people will be replacing David Hughes, the Eco-Congregations E&W Coordinator and livesimply award coordinator. First Ruth Valerio will work will work part time as Theology director and be part of A Rocha Management team. Ruth will be responsible for major changes to the programme and overall promotion of both schemes. Ruth will link into EIN. Second an Eco-Congregation England and Wales Coordinator/livesimply award coordinator will be appointed 3 days a week. And also Maria, the office administrator will continue to provide back office support from West London. Maria works full time and so is always available for routine assessment and support.
